title: Keeled snake scales with body patterns
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of snake skin: overlapping keeled scales on a rhombic lattice with python blotches, coral bands, dorsal diamonds or a plain speckled skin, coloured scale by scale. Use for snakes, lizards, dragons, reptile-leather goods and creature props.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python snake_scales.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: scales
parameters.meaning: Scale columns across the tile; rows follow from the scale length.

parameters.name: overlap
parameters.meaning: How much scales overlap; low values show the skin between them.

parameters.name: keel
parameters.meaning: Height of the ridge along each scale (0 for smooth scales).

parameters.name: pattern
parameters.meaning: 0 blotches with dark outlines, 1 cross bands, 2 dorsal diamonds, 3 plain with a fine speckle.

parameters.name: pattern_repeat
parameters.meaning: How many times the body pattern repeats across the tile.

parameters.name: gloss
parameters.meaning: Shine of the scales: 0 dry and matte, 1 freshly shed and glossy.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Olive and tan python skin with dark-edged blotches.

presets.name: coral_banded
presets.description: Banded red, black and yellow scales, smooth and glossy.

presets.name: diamondback
presets.description: Dusty brown skin with dark dorsal diamonds and strong keels.

presets.name: green_tree
presets.description: Bright green smooth scales with a fine speckle.

limits: Scales are rounded-diamond height fields of one size in regular offset rows; belly scutes, head plates and the change of scale size around the body are out of scope. The body axis runs along V with the head toward the top. Patterns are stylized fields sampled at scale centres, not the markings of real species, and there is no iridescence or shedding skin. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced. Colours are artistic.
technique_references: Rhombic lattice of offset rows with whole counts on the torus
Superellipse scale outline with exponent near 1 for pointed tips
Local overlap order: the row above covers the row below
Keel ridge along the scale axis
Pattern fields sampled once per scale centre
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
